name: pnp-powerplatform-samples-data-issue-desk
title: Data Issue Desk
shortDescription: Report, approve and escalate data quality issues with a responsive canvas app, four solution-aware cloud flows and Dataverse.
longDescription: Business users report data quality issues from a responsive canvas app. High and critical issues go through an approval, anyone can escalate an issue from the app, and the data team gets a daily email with the issues that are overdue. Every status change is written to an issue log, and every flow logs its own failures to a Flow error table.

thumbnails.alt: Issue list in the Data Issue Desk canvas app with status tabs, search and status labels
Issue detail screen with status, severity, data source, days open and the status history timeline
Daily overdue reminder email with an HTML table of open issues
